messages:
marco: Quick flag: in the latency dashboard for /v2/chat in ap-southeast, p95 dips below p50 briefly around 14:02 local. Screenshot: https://redwood.internal/dash/shot789 :eyes:
tina: That screams mixed-scope series (e.g., per-region quantile vs global median). Can you paste panel queries?
marco: panel has 3 series: p50 uses global rollup median, p95 uses region-specific tdigest p95, and p99 uses the new merged-rollup quantile. Queries: 
```
# p50: global rollup median
SELECT median(lat_ms) FROM rollup_agg WHERE endpoint='/v2/chat' GROUP BY time(1m)
# p95: region tdigest
SELECT quantile(0.95)(lat_ms) FROM tdigest('tq') WHERE region='ap-southeast' ...
# p99: merged-rollup quantile
SELECT quantile(0.99)(lat_ms) FROM rollup_quantiles WHERE region='ap-southeast'
```
eli: Ugh. Panel is comparing apples->oranges. Suggestion: either compute all percentiles from same derivation and scope or annotate clearly in legend. Also add a monotonicity sanity check alert that triggers when p50>p95 for same endpoint+time.
console-bot: logged UI ticket UI-4921 "legend: show derivation & scope for percentile series" by marcos.
dash-bot: noted INFRA-3335 for rollup->tdigest migration candidate.
tina: For now Marco can switch p50 to use region tdigest median to make chart consistent. If counts are low, we should also show the sample size series and a confidence interval band.
marco: Switched p50 to region tdigest. Deploying. dash-bot: dashboard patch applied at 14:27 UTC.
eli: Follow-ups: 1) add dashboard linter to flag mixed-derivation series 2) add a clipping rule on legend that shows "(mixed derivation)" and a hover explanation 3) infra: plan for consistent rollup tdigest storage.
tina: I'll take the linter change. eli, can you own the infra ticket?
eli: Yep. INFRA-3335 assigned to me.
marco: Chart now sane. Closing this thread, will open a short doc for "percentile provenance" in dashboards docs. Thanks.
